purpose: Define each external/input data source profile as an explicit identity describing source format, schema/version, origin and transport/adapter binding without using transport or filename as semantic identity.

owns: DWH Ingest Source Profile Identity semantics

topics.name: DWH Ingest Source Profile Identity
topics.purpose: Define each external/input data source profile as an explicit identity describing source format, schema/version, origin and transport/adapter binding without using transport or filename as semantic identity.

semantics.identity_rule: Every machine-significant ingest source profile has an explicit stable identity.
semantics.origin_rule: Source origin/provider/device/system identity is explicit where known.
semantics.binding_rule: Transport, adapter, endpoint or file binding is separate from source-profile identity.
semantics.scope_rule: Applicable input scope and destination mapping profile are explicit refs.
semantics.trust_rule: Source data is untrusted/inert input until validation completes.
semantics.ownership_rule: Source profile does not transfer source or destination semantic ownership.
semantics.authority_rule: Source reachability does not grant destination write authority.

invariants.rule: External/input data enters DWH only through explicit source profiles, exact field/schema mappings and validated transformations; mapping never transfers ownership, fabricates missing semantics or bypasses origin governance.

hard_gates.condition: filename used as source semantic identity
transport endpoint replaces source profile identity
source data treated as trusted canonical data

references.purpose: Ingest source is governed at origin.
Adapters may bind source transport without owning semantics.
